== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dellei Twinfire is a highly skilled combatant and the chosen champion of a [[Monarch]]. As an apprentice to a [[Monarch]], she possesses a unique and unpredictable spirit-bonding [[Path]] that makes her difficult for opponents to analyze. Although she has not yet reached the rank of Overlord, her presence exerts significant pressure on those she faces. Her abilities involve two fish-like spirits, each roughly the size of a human head, which coordinate with one another to mimic her movements and create the illusion of fighting multiple [[sacred artists]] simultaneously. Dellei is capable of alternating between paths of light and darkness, often using her twin swords to manipulate shadows into immaterial barriers that deflect physical force.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dellei Twinfire utilizes a unique spirit-bonding [[Path]] that allows for the switching between paths of light and darkness. This practitioner employs a pure white goldfish to control [[madra]] of light alongside a black goldfish that manipulates shadows.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As an apprentice to a [[Monarch]], Dellei Twinfire follows a highly unusual spirit-bonding [[Path]]. This unique ability allows for the seamless switching between a [[Path of light]] and a [[Path of darkness]]. To facilitate these transitions, Dellei utilizes two distinct goldfish: a pure white specimen that controls [[light madra]] and a black one used to manipulate shadows.}}
